quarterly_data.quarter: Sanofi press release: Press Release: Sanofi breaks ground on new state-of-the-art (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Sanofi broke ground on a new insulin manufacturing facility on a 36,000-square-meter footprint at its BioCampus in Frankfurt, Germany, designed to use digital technologies and AI across manufacturing and quality processes; full production of insulin active pharmaceutical ingredient is planned for 2032 once the facility is fully licensed. The Frankfurt BioCampus has around 4,000 employees dedicated to insulin and supplies approximately 20 insulin products; Sanofi supplies insulin to approximately 15 million people in more than 100 countries each year. In September 2026 the European Commission approved public support from the German Federal Government, the State of Hesse and the City of Frankfurt for the project.
quarterly_data.figure: 36,000-square-meter facility; full insulin API production planned for 2032; approximately 15 million people supplied
